title: Toolbox module — NTP/time-sync + Fail2Ban (extend in-place) + disk usage/curated cleaners (the safe, fully-smoke-testable slice of the v0.6 roadmap pin)
scopeNote: Next roadmap chapter after databases + backups. Near-verbatim clone of the shipped firewall pattern (which-probe → driver → Unavailable*Driver 503 → spawn runCommand). Ships ONLY the safe subset: NTP, Fail2Ban (extended in firewall module, ~70% built), disk usage + curated owned-target cleaners. Stateless — no migration. Swap-write + Supervisor deferred to v0.6.1; MFA to v0.7.0; Passkey blocked on TLS.

phases.name: Activation + shared shell/privilege contracts (lift run-command to common/shell, instanceof CommandError -> HttpException re-wrap standard + backfill firewall opaque-500 fix, TOOLBOX_REQUIRE_SUDO + sudo -n wrapper)
NTP / time-sync — module skeleton end-to-end (timedatectl show+status parse/set-ntp/set-timezone + optional chronyc, UnavailableNtpDriver 503, adversarial review applied)

Fail2Ban (extend firewall.service in place: jails/ban/runtime-toggle + sudo retrofit) + disk usage view (df/du) + curated cleaners (journald/dnf|apt/docker-prune; tmp-sweep dropped as unsafe; docker volumes excluded). Adversarial review applied
Web Toolbox UI — /toolbox/* splat route + tabs shell cloning routes/system, use-toolbox hooks, i18n (zh-TW + en)
Hardening, guardrail tests, docs/toolbox.md + consolidated NOPASSWD sudoers contract, shared rebuild
Release v0.6.0 (bump 0.5.0 -> 0.6.0, no migration) + Rocky 234 smoke S1-S5

directionDecisions.D1_scope: Toolbox slice only — NTP + Fail2Ban(extend in-place) + disk-usage + curated cleaners. Swap-write -> v0.6.1, Supervisor -> v0.6.1, MFA -> v0.7.0, Passkey -> TLS-gated (recommended default; operator-confirmable)
directionDecisions.D2_diskCleanupScope: curated owned-target categories only (journald vacuum / dnf|apt cache / docker prune / tmp sweep); NO arbitrary-path+age deleter
directionDecisions.D3_fail2ban: extend in place under firewall module; Toolbox tab is a view onto firewall.service (no route migration)
directionDecisions.D4_privilege: single TOOLBOX_REQUIRE_SUDO env + one consolidated NOPASSWD Cmnd_Alias (timedatectl, fail2ban-client, journalctl --vacuum, dnf|apt clean) + sudo -n wrapper + non-throwing boot probe
directionDecisions.D5_persistence: stateless for v0.6.0 — no drizzle migration, no scheduler task type
directionDecisions.D6_uiPlacement: new top-level /toolbox/* splat route + sidebar entry (Wrench)
directionDecisions.D7_mfaEscapeHatch: when MFA lands in v0.7.0, ship+test scripts/disable-mfa CLI escape hatch BEFORE the MFA endpoints (recorded now)
directionDecisions.D_bug_firewall500: verified: FirewallCommandError extends Error (not HttpException) so ApiExceptionFilter drops it to a generic 500; fix is the service-layer instanceof CommandError -> HttpException({code}) re-wrap, NOT the run-command internals (which already map errno). Right-sizes Phase 0 to 2 days.
